_about: Reference checklist for the Maya FK/IK leg tutorial (video dc3iRo0hb3g). 'items' come from what the first live run's own evidence says the video does (model-read, NOT checked by a person against the video). 'reference_only' are details from the project's quality example for orienting joints (select the root joint, open the Rigging menu set, apply, check the axes): a QUALITY TARGET, not ground truth, reported separately and not counted in completeness. A keyword group matches when all its words occur in the text of the step list.

items.name: position the joints on the mesh
duplicate the chain for IK and FK
rename the duplicates with search and replace
parent constrain the skin joints to IK and FK
give the attribute a 0 to 1 range
connect the attribute to the constraint weights
use a reverse node for the other weight
